scope: C++ TimeSeries aggregate-state representation on R44 cumulative R43+singleton: replace `State{TimeSeriesBucketsMap<Bucket> buckets; optional<SingleSample> singleton;}` with exclusive `std::variant<monostate,SingleSample,TimeSeriesBucketsMap<Bucket>>`.
